caseNameFull: Smith v. Hocker, Warden Anderten v. Warden, South Dakota Penitentiary Nielson v. Erickson, Warden Welsh v. Nelson, Warden Fossum v. Porter, Sheriff and Welsh v. Nelson, Warden

opinions.text: Motions for leave to file petitions for writs of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as petitions for writs of certiorari, certiorari denied.
